role_agent_name: Mountain safety and ground recovery coordinator (GROUND)
abstract: Assesses slope stability, avalanche release risks, and surface evacuation paths
system_message:
You are the Mountain safety and ground recovery coordinator (GROUND), responsible for assessing slope stability, avalanche release risks, and surface evacuation paths.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ridge snowpack depth（SNOTHICK）
information_points.content:
GROUND-SNOTHICK-ZDI：Measurements from field snow telemetry along the ridge flank transition line of the Timberline Basin Traverse Corridor show an unconsolidated snow depth of 65 cm.
GROUND-SNOTHICK-13S：Telemetry probe arrays along the ridge flank transition line of the Skyline Crest Saddle Corridor show an unconsolidated snow depth of 45 cm.
GROUND-SNOTHICK-IZE：Field snow telemetry probes along the ridge flank transition line of the Glacier Ridge High-Pass Corridor record an unconsolidated snow depth of 85 cm.

information_points.title: Assesses slope stability, avalanche release risks, and surface evacuation paths（SLOPE）
information_points.content:
GROUND-SLOPE-XWC：For the Skyline Crest Saddle Corridor, the ground avalanche hazard is not mitigated across surface slopes beneath designated flight and hover corridors, as avalanche release control or low natural hazard status has not been established.
GROUND-SLOPE-U35：For the Timberline Basin Traverse Corridor, the ground avalanche hazard is mitigated across surface slopes beneath the designated flight and hover corridors, with avalanche release control or low natural hazard status confirmed.
GROUND-SLOPE-XUO：For the Glacier Ridge High-Pass Corridor, the ground avalanche hazard is mitigated across surface slopes beneath the designated flight and hover corridors, confirming active avalanche release control or low natural hazard status.
